question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**caravan**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage refers to the art of carpet making.
 
• **Now, the blank 3 will describe the group of carpet makers from Persia.**
 
• **Thus, among the given options, the correct word to use in the blank is "caravan."** 
 
 
• The word 'caravan' refers to a group of travelers journeying together, typically in a line of vehicles.(कारवां)
 
• It can also refer to a covered wagon or a group of traders traveling together.
 
• Example: There was a caravan of pilgrims on their way to Mecca.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Crowd (Option 1) refers to a large group of people gathered together in a public place.(भीड़)
 
• Army (Option 2) refers to a large organized group of soldiers trained for warfare.(सेना)
 
• Band (Option 4) refers to a group of musicians who perform together.(बैंड बाजा)
